issues.legal_issue: An authority for whose benefit land is acquired and which bears the compensation must be given notice and an opportunity to be heard before a compensation reference is determined, and an award made without that opportunity is not binding on the authority and must be reconsidered.
material_facts: The land was acquired for the requirements of a municipal corporation, which bore the burden of paying compensation.
A court received a reference concerning compensation but issued no notice to the corporation.
The court determined the compensation on the basis of an agreement between the landowners and the State, without taking evidence on valuation.
The corporation was thereby deprived of the opportunity to present its case and evidence on valuation.
The High Court set aside the award and directed that the reference proceedings be reopened to allow the corporation to present evidence.
issues.conclusion: The corporation was entitled to notice and a hearing before determination of the reference. The award made without notice was illegal and not binding on the corporation, and the proceedings were properly ordered reopened for fresh determination after the corporation had an opportunity to lead evidence.
issues.legal_principle: Section 20(c) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as applicable in the State, requires notice to the person or authority for whom an acquisition is made when the acquisition is not for Government. The provision entitled the beneficiary corporation to be heard before determination of the compensation reference. The Court referred to Himalayan Tiles and Marbles (P) Ltd. v. Francis Victor Coutinho, [1980] 3 SCR 235, which interpreted “person interested” broadly, but held that it was unnecessary to interpret section 20(b) because section 20(c) specifically addressed the beneficiary authority.

rule.if: compensation_reference_case and acquisition_for_non_government_beneficiary and beneficiary_bears_compensation and beneficiary_received_no_notice and beneficiary_denied_opportunity

predicates.compensation_reference_case: A court is determining a reference concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.acquisition_for_non_government_beneficia: The land was acquired for the benefit of a person or authority other than Government.
predicates.beneficiary_bears_compensation: The beneficiary bears the burden of paying the compensation.
predicates.beneficiary_received_no_notice: The court did not notify the beneficiary before determining the reference.
predicates.beneficiary_denied_opportunity: The beneficiary was deprived of an opportunity to present its case before the reference was determined.
predicates.reference_award_is_not_binding_on_benefi: The award is not binding on the beneficiary, and the proceedings must be reopened for a determination that gives the beneficiary an opportunity to be heard.

issues.definition: When a compensation reference concerns land acquired for a non-government beneficiary that bears the compensation, and that beneficiary receives neither notice nor an opportunity to be heard, the award is not binding on it and the proceedings must be reopened.
